escenas.texto: Europe did not sleep this week. Thirty videos made this countdown, and together they add up to over two hundred and seventy-eight million views. Three lists, three crowns, and on one of them the gap between first and second is about one million views. Who took number one? You'll find out at the end of each list, not a second earlier. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, Europe edition: the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week.

The rules, quick and clear. Only videos posted in the last seven days that trended in Europe. One video per creator on each list. Music and news have their own space. Every number comes from the official YouTube API, measured this Wednesday. Let's go.

We open with the ten most viewed videos. Number ten, from the United Kingdom, Premier League, with “Max Dowman, the youngest goalscorer in Premier League history”. A Short of just sixteen seconds, and over seven point two million views in four days. Sixteen seconds of football history, and Europe hit replay.

Number nine, Unspoken Stories, with “Nobody Believed Him At First”. Over seven point three million views. And look at this: it's a channel with about ninety-eight thousand subscribers, beating giants this week. It has the best engagement rate on this list: five out of every hundred viewers liked or commented.
At number eight, FORMULA 1, with the race highlights of the 2026 United States Grand Prix. Over seven point five million views in just two days, and over two thousand comments.

Number seven, from Spain, Jajamaru. A Short of just twenty-seven seconds, posted six days ago. Over seven point nine million views. Keep this name in mind, because its likes will come back later tonight.
Number six, from the United Kingdom, John Nellis, with “I Tested Footballer’s Lungs”. Forty-three seconds, over eight point nine million views, and over sixty-nine thousand likes.

Number five, from the United Kingdom, Mrwhosetheboss, with “6 ways iPhone Duo beats Samsung”. Over eleven million views in a Short of fifty-four seconds, and over six thousand comments. The phone war is alive, and Europe picked a side.

Number four, from Germany, Dhruv Rathee, with a video posted four days ago. Over fifteen point four million views. A video over twenty minutes long, and people stayed. It also has over twenty-five thousand comments. Remember that number. And now, the podium.

Bronze medal, from Spain, YoSoyDander. A Short of just nineteen seconds, posted six days ago, with over fifteen point five million views. It edges out number four by less than two hundred thousand views. Tight. But the top two are in another league.

Silver medal, from Cyprus, crafter duck - DIY, with “Is This The Best Way To Recycle Plastic?”. Forty-nine seconds, over twenty point three million views in four days. Can anything beat that? Only one video this week.

And here it is. Number one most viewed in Europe, from the United Kingdom, DAZN Football, with the 2026 Ballon d'Or Red Carpet Pre Show. Over twenty-one point three million views in just one day. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about six hundred and forty thousand views per hour. A broadcast over seventy-two minutes long, and the world stayed for the red carpet. The crown goes to football.

Now we move from watching to talking: the ten most commented videos. Number ten, from Türkiye, Bakirkertenkele31, with a video posted three days ago. Over four thousand nine hundred comments, and over one point four million views. A video over thirty-eight minutes long, and the community still had plenty to say.
Number nine, from Ukraine, Domer Grief, with a Minecraft video posted two days ago. Over five thousand eight hundred comments and over one million views.

Number eight, Vsauce, with “The Magic Octagon”. Over six thousand five hundred comments and over four point eight million views. A puzzle that made people stop and write. And this video is not done with us tonight.
Number seven, from Poland, Czajnik, with a video posted five days ago. Under three minutes long, over one point two million views, and over seven thousand two hundred comments.
Number six, our underdog again: Unspoken Stories. Over eight thousand nine hundred comments, from a channel with about ninety-eight thousand subscribers. Its audience doesn't just watch. It reacts.

Number five, from the United Kingdom, Mrwhosetheboss again, now with a different video: “iPhone Duo is Messier Than You Think”. Over eleven thousand four hundred comments and over ten point three million views. Over twenty minutes of tech, and an endless debate below it.

Number four, from the United Kingdom, Beta Squad, with “Beta Squad Mafia Play-Along Edition”. Over twelve thousand five hundred comments. A video over eighty-three minutes long, and over four point six million views. Everyone wanted to guess the mafia. Now, the podium of the conversation.

Bronze medal, from Türkiye, Vural Üzül, with a gaming video posted four days ago. Over fourteen thousand two hundred comments with about two hundred and thirty-five thousand views. It has the best engagement rate on this list: fifteen out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. Forty-nine minutes, and a community on fire.

Silver medal, from Germany, Dhruv Rathee. Yes, the number four most viewed. Over twenty-five thousand two hundred comments. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about one hundred and fifty thousand views per hour. But someone doubled down this week.

Drum roll, please. Number one most commented in Europe, from the United Kingdom, The Diary Of A CEO, with “President Zelenskyy: It's Time To Tell You The Truth About The War!”. Over forty-five thousand seven hundred comments. Nearly twice the silver medal. A conversation over one hundred and nine minutes long, and over five point one million views.

And the last list, the one that measures love: the ten most liked videos. Number ten, from Cyprus, crafter duck - DIY, our silver medal in views. Over one hundred and fifty-nine thousand likes on that forty-nine second Short.
Number nine, from the United Kingdom, The Diary Of A CEO, the king of comments. Over one hundred and seventy-three thousand likes on a conversation over one hundred and nine minutes long.
Number eight, from the United Kingdom, DAZN Football, the Ballon d'Or pre show. Over two hundred and four thousand likes. Most viewed, yes. Most loved? Not even close to the top.
Number seven, BAS Renovations, with “Are your gutters installed right?”. Over two hundred and six thousand likes and over four point nine million views.

Number six, Jack Overton PT, with “Something’s gonna go pop”. Over two hundred and seventy-three thousand likes and over five million views. And look at this: it's a channel with about seventy-six thousand subscribers. Huge week.
Number five, Vsauce, “The Magic Octagon”. Over three hundred and five thousand likes. It has the best engagement rate on this list: six out of every hundred viewers liked or commented.

Number four, from Spain, Jajamaru. Remember that twenty-seven second Short? Over three hundred and twenty-six thousand likes on over seven point nine million views. We told you it would come back. Now, the podium, and it's tight.
Bronze medal, from the United Kingdom, Mrwhosetheboss, with “6 ways iPhone Duo beats Samsung”. Over three hundred and forty-six thousand likes.

Silver medal, Unspoken Stories, with “Nobody Believed Him At First”. Over three hundred and forty-nine thousand likes, just over three thousand ahead of the bronze. A channel with about ninety-eight thousand subscribers on the podium of love. Incredible. But number one is far ahead.

And here it is. Number one most liked in Europe, from Germany, Dhruv Rathee. Fourth in views, second in comments, and first in likes: over four hundred and ninety-seven thousand. Over one hundred and forty-seven thousand more than the silver medal. A video over twenty minutes long, with over fifteen million views. The most complete video of the week in Europe.

And some news: starting week forty-five we add TikTok. The ten most viral TikTok videos of the week, right here too. Don't miss it. And the world tour isn't over. Next stop: the Americas. The link is in the description and in the playlist. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell, so you're the first to know the winners in Europe every Sunday. And watch out: the top three of each list move on to the global ranking. Next week, that video could be yours. And a question for you: do you want us to hold a real award for the Top 10 winners? If you do, write the hashtag Premios Top 10 RS in the comments, all in one word.
